summary: Bake.events silently drops Banners that lack a UTC period (no matching schedule.yaml entry).
failure_scenario: Because Concrete.project excludes unmatched events and Predict is still a passthrough, every unscheduled banner is silently dropped from events.json. Until Predict is implemented, the output is a strict subset of known banners with no log/warning — easy to mistake for complete data.

summary: Bake.events filters to `isinstance(event, Banner)` only; any non-Banner Event in the Timeline is silently dropped.
failure_scenario: Bake.timeline collects from every Events collection, but the writer hard-codes Banner. The moment another Events subclass lands (scenarios, CMs as first-class events), it will be loaded into the timeline but never written. Either drop the filter and dispatch on type, or assert that the timeline only contains Banners.
todo: we'll fix this when we add another event type
